title: Fft Butterfly
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Fft
learningObjectives: Identify the input column, the intermediate stage columns, and the output column of the FFT butterfly network
Trace one butterfly operation through its characteristic X pattern, showing how a single input value contributes to two outputs
Explain why an N-point FFT requires log2(N) stages, and verify the stage count by stepping through the 4-, 8-, 16-, and 32-point sizes
Explain how divide-and-conquer recursion reduces the cost of the transform from N-squared to N log N operations
Describe why bit reversal is needed to place inputs in the order the butterfly network consumes them
